source.name: Astronomy Engine
source.method: GeoMoon(date) for the geometric geocentric Moon centre; RotateVector(Rotation_EQJ_ECL()) for the separate display frame.
source.algorithm: Nautical Almanac Office's Improved Lunar Ephemeris of 1954, derived from E. W. Brown's lunar theories, as documented by the pinned library.
source.generationTimestampBasis: Local deterministic manifest generation time; no remote catalogue retrieval occurs.
source.timeSemantics: Input selections are UTC milliseconds. The library approximates UT1 and UTC as equivalent and derives TT internally.

selection.quantization: Strict ISO UTC timestamps with millisecond resolution; no visitor-clock fallback.
selection.boundNote: The ±24 h window is an interaction bound, not an accuracy guarantee.

display.direction: EQJ/J2000 source retained; ECL/J2000 direction preserved through a fixed display mapping.
display.radialScale: Fixed 3.45 scene units around an Earth globe of radius 2 before common screen-fit scaling; geocentric kilometres remain in the data readout.
display.bodyMarker: An enlarged schematic marker, not an observed surface portrait. Scene lighting is compositional and is not a calculated lunar phase.
display.earthTextureRegistration: The composite Earth texture is not time-registered; no ground track, visibility, or pointing claim is made.

trace.note: A 25-sample local GeoMoon trace centred as near as the selection bounds allow; not an observed path.
